import Foundation
import XCTest

@testable import shortcuts_example

/// Recreates three workbooks downloaded from the internet (ExcelDemy sample
/// datasets and a Smartsheet template) from a blank workbook using only the
/// AI chat, at the original cell addresses. Generated by
/// scratchpad/net/gen_fixtures.py; opt-in because it calls the live model.
@MainActor
final class ExcelAIChatInternetRecreationTests: XCTestCase {
    private struct Turn {
        var select: String? = nil
        /// nil = verification-only turn (no chat request).
        let request: String?
        let verify: (ExcelWorkbookViewModel) throws -> Void
    }

    /// Thrown by expectValues so the harness can ask the assistant to fix
    /// the exact cells, the way a user would after spotting a typo.
    private struct ValueMismatchError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
        let mismatches: [(address: ExcelCellAddress, expected: String, actual: String)]
        var description: String {
            "값 불일치 \(mismatches.count)건: "
                + mismatches.prefix(10).map {
                    "\($0.address.reference): '\($0.actual)' != '\($0.expected)'"
                }.joined(separator: ", ")
        }
    }

    private struct Fixture {
        let outputName: String
        let turns: [Turn]
    }

    func testRecreateInternetWorkbooksThroughLiveAIChat() async throws {
        #if !EXCEL_AI_LIVE_RECREATE
        throw XCTSkip(
            "EXCEL_AI_LIVE_RECREATE에서만 실제 AI 채팅 재현을 실행합니다."
        )
        #else
        FirebaseRuntime.configureIfAvailable()
        guard FirebaseRuntime.isConfigured else {
            XCTFail("Firebase가 구성되지 않았습니다.")
            return
        }

        let budget = await CloudAITokenBudgetStore.shared.refillForTesting()
        print("EXCEL_AI_NET_TOKEN_BUDGET \(budget.remainingTokens)")

        let outputDirectory = try Self.outputDirectory()
        let selected = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["EXCEL_AI_NET_ONLY"]
        for fixture in Self.fixtures {
            if let selected, !selected.isEmpty,
               !fixture.outputName.contains(selected) {
                continue
            }
            let data = try await recreate(fixture)
            let outputURL = outputDirectory
                .appendingPathComponent(fixture.outputName)
            try data.write(to: outputURL, options: .atomic)
            let attachment = XCTAttachment(
                data: data,
                uniformTypeIdentifier:
                    "org.openxmlformats.spreadsheetml.sheet"
            )
            attachment.name = fixture.outputName
            attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
            add(attachment)
            print(
                "EXCEL_AI_NET_OUTPUT "
                    + outputURL.path
                    + " bytes=\(data.count)"
            )
        }
        #endif
    }

    private func recreate(_ fixture: Fixture) async throws -> Data {
        let sourceURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(
                "AIChatNet-\(UUID().uuidString).xlsx"
            )
        try ExcelWorkbookDocument.blankWorkbookData().write(to: sourceURL)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: sourceURL) }

        let workbook = ExcelWorkbookViewModel(fileURL: sourceURL)
        await workbook.load()
        let chat = ExcelAIChatViewModel()

        for (index, turn) in fixture.turns.enumerated() {
            print(
                "EXCEL_AI_NET_TURN \(fixture.outputName) #\(index + 1)"
            )
            if let select = turn.select,
               let address = ExcelCellAddress(select) {
                workbook.selectCell(address)
            }
            if let request = turn.request {
                var applied = await send(request, chat: chat, workbook: workbook)
                if !applied {
                    // One retry: the model occasionally times out or returns
                    // a plan the validator rejects; a user would just resend.
                    print("EXCEL_AI_NET_RETRY \(fixture.outputName) #\(index + 1)")
                    applied = await send(request, chat: chat, workbook: workbook)
                }
                XCTAssertTrue(
                    applied,
                    "\(fixture.outputName) turn \(index + 1) 적용 실패"
                )
            }
            var repairs = 0
            while true {
                do {
                    try turn.verify(workbook)
                    print(
                        "EXCEL_AI_NET_VERIFY \(fixture.outputName) #\(index + 1) ok"
                            + (repairs > 0 ? " (수정 \(repairs)회)" : "")
                    )
                    break
                } catch let mismatch as ValueMismatchError where repairs < 3 {
                    // Ask the assistant to fix the wrong cells by address,
                    // exactly as a user proofreading the sheet would.
                    repairs += 1
                    print(
                        "EXCEL_AI_NET_REPAIR \(fixture.outputName) #\(index + 1) "
                            + "\(mismatch)"
                    )
                    let fixes = mismatch.mismatches.prefix(40).map {
                        "\($0.address.reference) 셀은 "
                            + ($0.expected.isEmpty ? "비워줘" : "'\($0.expected)' 로 바꿔줘")
                    }
                    let request = "다음 셀들을 고쳐줘. 다른 셀은 건드리지 마.\n"
                        + fixes.joined(separator: "\n")
                    let applied = await send(request, chat: chat, workbook: workbook)
                    XCTAssertTrue(
                        applied,
                        "\(fixture.outputName) turn \(index + 1) 수정 요청 실패"
                    )
                } catch {
                    XCTFail(
                        "\(fixture.outputName) turn \(index + 1) 검증 실패: \(error)"
                    )
                    break
                }
            }
        }

        return try await workbook.exportData()
    }

    private func send(
        _ request: String,
        chat: ExcelAIChatViewModel,
        workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel
    ) async -> Bool {
        let messageCount = chat.messages.count
        chat.input = request
        await chat.send(
            snapshotProvider: { request in
                try await workbook.makeAISnapshot(for: request)
            },
            applying: { plan in
                try workbook.applyAIPlan(plan)
            }
        )
        let newMessages = chat.messages.dropFirst(messageCount)
        for message in newMessages {
            print(
                "EXCEL_AI_NET_CHAT role=\(message.role) "
                    + message.text.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n", with: " ")
                        .prefix(300)
            )
        }
        if newMessages.contains(where: {
            $0.role == .notice && $0.text.contains("적용할 변경 내용이 없습니다")
        }) {
            return true // already in the requested state
        }
        return newMessages.contains(where: { $0.role == .assistant })
            && newMessages.contains(where: { $0.role == .notice })
            && !newMessages.contains(where: {
                $0.role == .notice
                    && ($0.text.contains("처리하지 못했습니다")
                        || $0.text.contains("파일은 변경되지 않았습니다"))
            })
    }

    // MARK: - Verification helpers

    private struct VerificationError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
        let description: String
    }

    private static func fail(_ message: String) -> VerificationError {
        VerificationError(description: message)
    }

    private static func sheet(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel
    ) throws -> ExcelWorksheet {
        guard let sheet = workbook.selectedSheet else {
            throw fail("선택된 시트가 없습니다.")
        }
        return sheet
    }

    private static func expectTable(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        range reference: String,
        headers: [String]
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        guard let expected = ExcelCellRange(reference) else {
            throw fail("잘못된 범위 \(reference)")
        }
        guard let table = sheet.tables.first(where: { $0.range == expected }) else {
            throw fail(
                "표 \(reference) 없음. 현재 표: "
                    + sheet.tables.map(\.range.reference).joined(separator: ", ")
            )
        }
        guard table.columnNames == headers else {
            throw fail("표 머리글 \(table.columnNames) != \(headers)")
        }
    }

    private static func expectValues(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        rows: [[String]],
        startRow: Int,
        startColumn: Int
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        var mismatches = [(address: ExcelCellAddress, expected: String, actual: String)]()
        for (rowOffset, row) in rows.enumerated() {
            for (columnOffset, expected) in row.enumerated() {
                let address = ExcelCellAddress(
                    row: startRow + rowOffset,
                    column: startColumn + columnOffset
                )
                let cell = sheet.cell(at: address)
                let actual: String
                if expected.hasPrefix("=") {
                    actual = cell?.formula.map { "=" + $0 } ?? ""
                } else if Double(expected) != nil {
                    actual = cell?.rawValue ?? ""
                } else {
                    actual = cell?.displayValue ?? ""
                }
                let numericallyEqual = Double(expected).map {
                    $0 == Double(actual)
                } ?? false
                if actual != expected, !numericallyEqual {
                    mismatches.append((address, expected, actual))
                }
            }
        }
        guard mismatches.isEmpty else {
            throw ValueMismatchError(mismatches: mismatches)
        }
    }

    /// Cells the original never had must stay empty; surplus rows the
    /// model appended are reported as mismatches so the repair turn clears them.
    private static func expectNoValues(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        rows: ClosedRange<Int>,
        columns: ClosedRange<Int>
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        var extras = [(address: ExcelCellAddress, expected: String, actual: String)]()
        for row in rows {
            for column in columns {
                let address = ExcelCellAddress(row: row, column: column)
                if let cell = sheet.cell(at: address) {
                    let actual = cell.formula.map { "=" + $0 } ?? cell.displayValue
                    if !actual.isEmpty {
                        extras.append((address, "", actual))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        guard extras.isEmpty else {
            throw ValueMismatchError(mismatches: extras)
        }
    }

    private static func expectNumberFormat(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        _ format: ExcelNumberFormat,
        column: Int,
        rows: ClosedRange<Int>
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        guard let document = workbook.workbook else {
            throw fail("워크북이 없습니다.")
        }
        var wrong = [String]()
        for row in rows {
            let address = ExcelCellAddress(row: row, column: column)
            guard let cell = sheet.cell(at: address) else { continue }
            let style = document.style(at: cell.styleIndex)
            if ExcelNumberFormat.matching(style) != format {
                wrong.append(address.reference)
            }
        }
        guard wrong.isEmpty else {
            throw fail(
                "\(format.rawValue) 표시 형식 누락: "
                    + wrong.prefix(8).joined(separator: ", ")
            )
        }
    }

    private static func expectDropdown(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        values: [String],
        column: Int,
        rows: ClosedRange<Int>
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        var missing = [String]()
        for row in rows {
            let address = ExcelCellAddress(row: row, column: column)
            let rule = sheet.dataValidations.first { $0.contains(address) }
            if rule?.inlineListValues != values {
                missing.append(address.reference)
            }
        }
        guard missing.isEmpty else {
            throw fail(
                "드롭다운 \(values) 누락: "
                    + missing.prefix(8).joined(separator: ", ")
            )
        }
    }

    private static func expectConditionalRule(
        _ workbook: ExcelWorkbookViewModel,
        kind: ExcelConditionalRuleKind,
        comparisonValue: String,
        highlight: ExcelConditionalHighlight,
        column: Int,
        rows: ClosedRange<Int>
    ) throws {
        let sheet = try sheet(workbook)
        guard let document = workbook.workbook else {
            throw fail("워크북이 없습니다.")
        }
        var missing = [String]()
        for row in rows {
            let address = ExcelCellAddress(row: row, column: column)
            let matches = sheet.conditionalFormatting.contains { block in
                block.ranges.contains(where: { $0.contains(address) })
                    && block.rules.contains { rule in
                        guard rule.kind == kind else { return false }
                        let valueMatches = kind.requiresNumber
                            ? Double(rule.comparisonValue) == Double(comparisonValue)
                            : rule.comparisonValue.caseInsensitiveCompare(comparisonValue) == .orderedSame
                        guard valueMatches,
                              document.differentialStyles.indices.contains(
                                  rule.differentialStyleIndex
                              ) else { return false }
                        return ExcelConditionalHighlight.matching(
                            document.differentialStyles[rule.differentialStyleIndex]
                        ) == highlight
                    }
            }
            if !matches {
                missing.append(address.reference)
            }
        }
        guard missing.isEmpty else {
            throw fail(
                "조건부 서식 \(kind.rawValue) \(comparisonValue) \(highlight.rawValue) 누락: "
                    + missing.prefix(8).joined(separator: ", ")
            )
        }
    }

    private static func outputDirectory() throws -> URL {
        let documents = try FileManager.default.url(
            for: .documentDirectory,
            in: .userDomainMask,
            appropriateFor: nil,
            create: true
        )
        let directory = documents
            .appendingPathComponent("AIChatRecreation", isDirectory: true)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: directory,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true
        )
        return directory
    }

    // MARK: - Fixtures (generated)

    private static let fixtures: [Fixture] = [
__FIXTURES__
    ]
}
